note: Infrastructure and development mega projects that move land prices: ring roads, motorways, expressways, mass transit, rail, new sectors / subdivisions, industrial & special economic zones, airports and business districts. Compiled from public announcements up to mid-2026. Routes and boundaries are approximate (drawn for orientation, not survey accuracy) and status / dates change; confirm with the executing authority before relying on them.

projects.name: Rawalpindi Ring Road (RRR)
projects.summary: Six-lane access-controlled ring road from Banth (GT Road, near Rawat) to Thalian on the M-2 motorway, with interchanges on Chak Beli Khan Road, Adyala Road and Chakri Road. Takes heavy traffic off GT Road and the city.
projects.impact: Land along Adyala, Chakri and Chak Beli Khan roads becomes minutes from the motorway and the new airport; interchanges create commercial and logistics nodes. Expect the strongest uplift within 2–3 km of an interchange.

projects.name: Margalla Avenue
projects.summary: Signal-free avenue along the foot of the Margalla Hills from the Kashmir Highway near D-12 to GT Road near B-17 / Sangjani, opening the city's western D and C sectors.
projects.impact: Brings D-12, D-13, D-14, C-13 to C-16, B-17 and the Sangjani belt within a short drive of Blue Area and the motorway; supports CDA's new-sector launches.

projects.name: Nullah Leh Expressway & flood channel
projects.summary: Flood channel and elevated road along Nullah Leh from Kattarian (Islamabad border) through central Rawalpindi towards the Soan.
projects.impact: Flood protection and a fast north–south route through the old city; a redevelopment opportunity along the nullah banks once land acquisition is settled.

projects.name: CDA Sector E-12
projects.summary: Long-delayed CDA residential sector west of E-11, with roads and services being laid in phases.
projects.impact: Once services reach a sub-sector, plot prices typically jump towards E-11 levels; possession timing is the main risk.

projects.name: CDA Sector I-15
projects.summary: CDA residential sector off the Kashmir Highway / IJP corridor towards Tarnol, under development with phased possession.
projects.impact: Affordable CDA plots near the M-1/M-2 junction and the airport road; prices follow the pace of possession and utilities.

projects.name: CDA Sectors C-14 / C-15 / C-16
projects.summary: New CDA sectors along Margalla Avenue, west of D-12, with plot auctions and infrastructure under way.
projects.impact: Margalla Avenue frontage plus hill views; one of the capital's main supply pipelines for new residential plots.

projects.name: Lahore Ring Road — Southern Loop 3
projects.summary: Closes the southern gap of the Lahore Ring Road between Adda Plot (Raiwind Road) and Thokar Niaz Baig / Multan Road and the M-2.
projects.impact: Bahria Town, Lake City, Raiwind Road and Multan Road schemes get direct ring-road access; interchanges lift commercial land.

projects.name: Ravi Riverfront Urban Development (RUDA)
projects.summary: New city along a channelised Ravi river north-west of Lahore: river training, barrages, urban forest and new residential, commercial and industrial sectors.
projects.impact: A long-term growth corridor; early phases near Shahdara and the M-2 move first. Land-acquisition litigation and environmental clearance are key risks.

projects.name: Central Business District Punjab (Walton)
projects.summary: High-rise business district on the old Walton airfield, with a signal-free corridor connecting it to Gulberg and DHA.
projects.impact: Commercial demand and premium apartments in Walton, Cantt, Gulberg III and DHA Phase I–III; office supply competition for older Gulberg plazas.

projects.name: Quaid-e-Azam Business Park (SEZ)
projects.summary: Special economic zone on the M-2 motorway near Sheikhupura for export manufacturing.
projects.impact: Worker housing, rentals and commercial plots in nearby Sheikhupura and Kot Abdul Malik schemes.

projects.name: Allama Iqbal Industrial City (CPEC SEZ)
projects.summary: CPEC special economic zone on the M-4 at Sahianwala interchange, Faisalabad.
projects.impact: Jobs-led demand for housing along Sargodha Road and the M-4 corridor; industrial land prices in the area.

projects.name: Malir Expressway
projects.summary: Access-controlled expressway along the Malir River from Jam Sadiq Bridge (Korangi) to the M-9 motorway near Kathore.
projects.impact: Cuts DHA / Korangi to M-9 travel time sharply; schemes along the M-9 (Bahria Town, DHA City, Education City) and Malir gain access.

projects.name: Karachi BRT Red Line
projects.name_ur: کراچی بی آر ٹی ریڈ لائن
projects.summary: Bus rapid transit from Malir Halt to Numaish along University Road, linking to the Green Line.
projects.impact: Station areas along University Road and Gulshan-e-Iqbal gain footfall; apartments within walking distance of stations rent faster.

projects.name: Karachi Circular Railway (KCR) revival
projects.summary: Rebuilding the circular commuter railway through Gulshan, Gilani, Orangi and SITE back to City Station.
projects.impact: If built, station catchments (Gilani, Liaquatabad, Orangi, SITE) would see transit-oriented redevelopment; long-delayed, so price effect so far is limited.

projects.name: Dhabeji Special Economic Zone
projects.summary: CPEC special economic zone near Dhabeji on the National Highway, east of Port Qasim.
projects.impact: Industrial and worker-housing demand along the N-5 between Port Qasim and Gharo.

projects.name: M-6 Hyderabad–Sukkur Motorway
projects.summary: The missing Karachi–Peshawar motorway link between Hyderabad and Sukkur, built in sections.
projects.impact: Interchange towns (Hala, Moro, Naushahro Feroz, Rohri) gain logistics and commercial land demand; the Sindh corridor's biggest connectivity project.

projects.name: ML-1 Railway upgrade (Karachi–Peshawar)
projects.summary: Doubling and upgrading the main line from Karachi to Peshawar for 160 km/h passenger trains and heavier freight.
projects.impact: Faster intercity travel strengthens station towns; dry ports and freight terminals along the line create industrial land demand.

projects.name: Swat Expressway Phase II (Chakdara–Fatehpur)
projects.summary: Extends the Swat motorway from Chakdara up the valley past Mingora to Fatehpur.
projects.impact: Tourism real estate (hotels, holiday homes) and Mingora's urban fringe; faster access from Islamabad and Peshawar.

projects.name: Rashakai Special Economic Zone
projects.authority: KP Economic Zones Development & Management Co.
projects.summary: CPEC priority special economic zone on the M-1 at Rashakai interchange, Nowshera.
projects.impact: Industrial plots and workforce housing between Nowshera and Mardan along the M-1.

projects.name: New Gwadar International Airport
projects.summary: Pakistan's largest greenfield airport, north-east of Gwadar city, built with Chinese assistance.
projects.impact: Supports Gwadar's port-city plans; land near the airport and the coastal highway is speculative and needs careful title checks.

projects.name: Gwadar Free Zone (North)
projects.summary: Free-trade and industrial zone serving Gwadar port.
projects.impact: Warehousing and industrial land; housing demand depends on actual factory start-ups.
